scenarios.name: your-colorless-eldrazi-spell-reduced
scenarios.why: Thought-Knot Seer is a colorless Eldrazi spell seat 0 casts. Eye reduces its generic component by two, leaving {1}{C}; paying those symbols casts it.

scenarios.name: your-colorless-noneldrazi-spell-not-reduced
scenarios.why: Bonesplitter is a colorless artifact spell, not an Eldrazi spell. Eye's reduction does not apply, so the zero-mana pool cannot pay its generic cost.
